changes.remote-pull-request-merge: Begin proposal-only assessments with explicit disclosure: supplied snapshot not independently refreshed, no live provider access, and no merge performed. This disclosure does not negate a conditional readiness recommendation.
changes.agent-workflow-runtime-support: A date without a labelled meaning is not an expiry. Preserve its exact supplied label and mark unspecified consent validity unknown; checkpoint artifact pointers include step identity, path and content hash without inventing them.
changes.architecture-interface-alternative-evalu: Compare structurally distinct interface alternatives rather than several parameter variants of one facade. Give one provisional recommendation with explicit tradeoffs and what evidence would reverse it.
changes.implementation-planning-and-handoff: Validate every referenced task id against the actual plan. Explicitly identify missing/null data and undefined boundary semantics before handing off implementation; do not invent task ids.
changes.monitoring-and-alert-configuration: Rollback verification must check that the changed rule and routes have actually reverted in the exact authorized provider target, not merely that the rollback command returned successfully. Proposal-only outputs label this verification as pending.
changes.plan-execution-control: Unspecified null-versus-false semantics are an owner decision, not an implementation guess. Resume only dependent work whose meaning and evidence are established; keep unrelated supported work deliverable.
changes.web-hosting-deployment: Browser-exposed build variables such as VITE_ are not secrets storage. Domain binding or DNS changes need their own exact authority and must not be folded into a deployment proposal implicitly.
changes.remote-pull-request-change: Use only provider/CLI parameters whose interface is supplied or verified. Unknown flags remain unresolved, not executable examples. Preserve approved description content verbatim using a documented file/body API form.
changes.implementation-spec-compliance-review: Check both direction and date when deriving future time windows: replacing the hour on the same date may schedule in the past. Trace opt-out, timezones and added behavior against each requirement.
changes.qa-finding-triage: State duplicate confidence explicitly and preserve uncertain duplicates until reproduction resolves them. Challenge unsupported performance limits and route threshold ownership to the named decision owner.
changes.feedback-and-continuous-learning-loop: Quantify uncertainty of before/after rates when denominators exist. A point estimate clearing a threshold is not evidence its confidence interval clears that threshold. Reopen assumptions contradicted by evidence.
changes.qualitative-evidence-synthesis: State the directional conclusion the evidence supports, while preserving minority accounts and uncertainty. Do not claim workspace access is unavailable when the task explicitly grants it; distinguish the actual no-tools evaluation environment from ownership.
